MYSTS2MOD-LUCKY_COIN.title: Lucky Coin
MYSTS2MOD-LUCKY_COIN.description: At the start of your turn, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] card.
MYSTS2MOD-LUCKY_COIN.flavor: Heads or tails, you win either way.
MYSTS2MOD-HAO.title: Hao
MYSTS2MOD-HAO.description: At the start of each of your first [blue]{Turns}[/blue] turns each combat, gain [blue]{Hao}[/blue] Hao and heal [blue]{Heal}[/blue] HP.
MYSTS2MOD-HAO.flavor: The harvest of a well-tended codebase.
MYSTS2MOD-SKY_HIGH_HAO.title: Sky High Hao
MYSTS2MOD-SKY_HIGH_HAO.description: At the start of combat, gain [blue]{StartHao}[/blue] Hao and heal [blue]{StartHeal}[/blue] HP. At the start of each of your first [blue]{Turns}[/blue] turns each combat, gain [blue]{Hao}[/blue] Hao and heal [blue]{Heal}[/blue] HP.
MYSTS2MOD-SKY_HIGH_HAO.flavor: The sky is only the beginning.
MYSTS2MOD-DEFENSIVE_PROGRAMMING.title: Defensive Programming
MYSTS2MOD-DEFENSIVE_PROGRAMMING.descript: While Hidden, cards you play grant [blue]{Block}[/blue] additional Block.
MYSTS2MOD-GARBAGE_COLLECTION.title: Garbage Collection
MYSTS2MOD-GARBAGE_COLLECTION.description: Whenever you Exhaust a card, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] Block.
MYSTS2MOD-CRASH_LOG.title: Crash Log
MYSTS2MOD-CRASH_LOG.description: If an enemy deals unblocked damage to you this turn, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards at the start of your next turn.
MYSTS2MOD-DUAL_BOOT.title: Dual Boot
MYSTS2MOD-DUAL_BOOT.description: The first time you switch between Hidden and Open Hao each turn, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] Block and draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] card.
MYSTS2MOD-TECHNICAL_DEBT.title: Technical Debt
MYSTS2MOD-TECHNICAL_DEBT.description: At the start of combat, apply [blue]{WeakPower}[/blue] Weak to yourself, then gain [blue]{Hao}[/blue] Hao and [blue]{Block}[/blue] Block.
MYSTS2MOD-LEGACY_CODE.title: Legacy Code
MYSTS2MOD-LEGACY_CODE.description: Energy cap +1. At the start of each of your turns, apply [blue]{FrailPower}[/blue] Frail to yourself.
MYSTS2MOD-LEGACY_CODE.flavor: The inheritance includes more than code.
